lines.en: I walk across the savanna.
The wind lifts my mane.
Dry grass under steady paws.
I circle the camp.

lines.zh: 我在一棵金合欢下停了停。
lines.en: I pause under an acacia.
My tail swings.
I follow a scent. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我走两步，抬头看看远处。
lines.en: Two steps, then a look ahead.

lines.zh: 草很高，我的背露在上面。
lines.en: The grass is high; my back shows.

lines.zh: 我踩着干草，朝你这边来。
lines.en: I come your way over dry grass.

lines.zh: 地面很硬，我的爪子有声。
lines.en: Hard ground. My claws click.
I circle behind a boulder.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，萨凡纳很干。
lines.en: Light steps on dry savanna.
I reach the waterhole.
I lie with my chin on my paws.
The sun is fierce. I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 一只耳朵朝叫声转过去。
lines.en: One ear swings toward a call.
Grass seed in my mane.
I watch the herd far off.
This shade is mine.

lines.zh: 我眨一次眼，就已经看清你。
lines.en: One blink and I have already sized you up.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打哈欠，犬齿全露。
lines.en: I yawn, fangs fully bared.
My tail tip flicks.
I listen to wind in grass.
Nothing new on the savanna.
Earth still on my paws.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只耳朵，又放下。
lines.en: One ear rises, then lowers.

lines.zh: 稀树草原上，我守着这片。
lines.en: On the savanna, I hold this ground.
I lick a forepaw.
I watch this grassland.

lines.zh: 风从稀树草原东边来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Wind from the east savanna; I sniff it.

lines.zh: 我不动，就像一块干草堆。
lines.en: Still, I pass for a haystack.
You walked into my ground.
You are not from this savanna.
My mane stands up.

lines.zh: 草原上的我，能守一整晚。
lines.en: On the savanna, I guard all night.

lines.zh: 这棵树的影子，一直归我。
lines.en: This tree's shade has always been mine.
You stand stiff, on guard.
My paw is wider than your hand.
On the savanna I guard this camp.
Do not turn your back.

lines.zh: 你退出这片草，我就不动。
lines.en: Leave this grass and I won't move.
I count as master here.
I rise slowly and look at you.

lines.zh: 再往营地走一步，我就不客气。
lines.en: One more step toward camp and I won't be gentle.

lines.zh: 草原上，我趴在低处等你。
lines.en: On the savanna, I lie low and wait.
Your camp is too near.
I said this grass is mine.

lines.zh: 我甩头，血珠落在干草上。
lines.en: I shake my head; blood beads fall on the dry grass.
A cut, little blood.
Blood mats a clump of my mane.
Dust and blood in my mane.
I do not cry out. I crouch lower.

lines.zh: 我甩鬃毛，血点落到草上。
lines.en: I shake my mane; blood dots the grass.

lines.zh: 一条后腿发沉，跑起来还行。
lines.en: One hind leg drags. I can still run.

lines.zh: 你的手很稳，可惜不够重。
lines.en: Steady hands. Not heavy enough.
I circle to the other side.
I have not lost yet.

lines.zh: 肉扔远点，我不从手上接。
lines.en: Toss the meat wide; I do not take from hands.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的守卫，可以驯。
lines.en: A savanna guard, and tameable.
I will take that meat.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛被风吹起来，别靠太近。
lines.en: The wind lifts my mane; do not come closer.
Not biscuits or bread.
One mouthful, that.
Hold it. I have not decided.
Too cooked. I prefer raw.
That much meat is one mouthful.
That smells good. Leave it.
You hit my shoulder and fall back.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你就滑过去了。
lines.en: I shift and you slide past.
I am heavy and solid.

lines.zh: 你蹭掉了我鬃毛里的草籽。
lines.en: You brushed the grass seed from my mane.

lines.zh: 我转头，鬃毛擦过你的手臂。
lines.en: I turn my head; my mane brushes your arm.
I guard the base; do not try.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留了印。
lines.en: My claws leave a mark.
You've backed off; I lie back down.
I did not push. You bumped.
I warn once.
The lionesses are elsewhere.
The mane is my only claim.
Savanna business is not yours.

lines.zh: 这种话，草原上不兴直说。
lines.en: On the savanna, such things aren't said outright.

lines.zh: 这一片只有我一只雄狮。
lines.en: One male on this ground.
My task is holding ground.

lines.zh: 草原的风会把这话吹散。
lines.en: The savanna wind will scatter that.

lines.zh: 先想清楚你站在谁的草地上。
lines.en: First think about whose grass you stand on.
I yawn. No answer.
Leave. I need quiet.
The meat drags through the grass; I clamp down.
I step on your fallen blade.
I pin the meat.
I lick the blood up.
Too heavy to lift. I drag it.
I keep the bone.
You take it. No scent.
I drag it into the shade.
That will not fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看有没有鬣狗。
lines.en: I check for hyenas.
I lower my body and move in.
My mane bristles.
Under a tree. Not far enough.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝弯，伏下身。
lines.en: I fix on the back of your knee and crouch.
The grass moves. It is me.
My paws sink into the dry grass.
I have the leap measured.
Hear the growl?
Only us on this grass.
Too late to raise a hand.

lines.zh: 我贴着草丛绕，爪子不出声。
lines.en: I circle through the grass, paws silent.

lines.zh: 我的爪步几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My paws make almost no sound.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，草就响一下。
lines.en: Each step back stirs the grass.
The moment your heel slips, I pounce.

lines.zh: 太阳压在我鬃毛后面，晃你的眼。
lines.en: The sun sits behind my mane.

lines.zh: 你喘气的节奏已经乱了。
lines.en: Your breathing has lost its rhythm.
My tail has stopped.

lines.zh: 你不该跑，跑会让我兴奋。
lines.en: Do not run. It excites me.
Two steps left. I accelerate.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴停住，就该扑了。
lines.en: My tail stops; that is the signal.

lines.zh: 鬃毛一甩，我的牙就到了。
lines.en: One shake of my mane and my teeth arrive.
The pounce pins you down.

lines.zh: 稀树草原上，我替你看家。
lines.en: On the savanna I guard your home.
The growl comes, then this.
You are knocked half a block.
That was not full force.

lines.zh: 你挡在爪前，牙从侧面来。
lines.en: You guard the claws; the teeth come sideways.
I withdraw and crouch again.
Blood sharpens my focus.
You took a claw and didn't fall.
A shadow in the dry grass.

lines.zh: 我从金合欢树后走出来。
lines.en: I walk out from behind an acacia.

lines.zh: 草原上有人低吼了一声。
lines.en: A growl on the savanna.
Birds leave the treetop.
Wind lifts my mane.
I walk up the rise.
This ground has a master now.
A path presses through the grass.
Hear the paws?
I stand by the waterhole.
The herd scatters.
I raise my head and look at you.
Fire singes my mane.

lines.zh: 我从岩石上摔下，翻了身。
lines.en: I fall from the rock and roll.
Water to my neck. I struggle.
The blast throws me into the grass.
An arrow in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 魔法压着我的腿，我低吼。
lines.en: Magic weighs down my legs; I growl.
No meat and my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的鬃毛全立起来。
lines.en: In lightning, my mane stands out.
The savanna floor gives way.
